part_a_domain_grouped_mtl.architecture: DomainMTLNet: Modality-gated 4-FM + Physchem projections (774D -> 384D) + 2x LayerNorm Residual Bottleneck MLP blocks (384->192->384) + Task-Specific Condition Heads + Homoscedastic Uncertainty Task Weighting (Kendall et al. 2018) + Native Censored-Aware Huber Hinge Loss
part_a_domain_grouped_mtl.zero_peeking_promotion_rule: Decided STRICTLY on nested 5-fold cluster-grouped OOF CV (holdout NEVER inspected for selection). Regression: rel MAE imp >= 0.5% AND abs MAE imp >= 0.002 AND w_mtl >= 0.05 AND OOF Spearman delta >= -0.01. Classification: (Brier imp >= 0.0005 OR (AUC imp >= 0.001 AND Brier imp >= -0.001)) AND w_mtl >= 0.05.
part_a_domain_grouped_mtl.zero_leakage_guarantee: For every (target_ep, fold), auxiliary domain tasks exclude ALL holdout rows plus ALL rows sharing global cluster_id, local cluster_id, or compound_key with target_va or target_ho. Runtime assertions verified 0/0 leaks.

part_b_fda_2019_2023_blind_full_stack.stack_architecture: Full Reproducible 3-Family Stack: CPU + 4-FM Modality-Aware Fusion + Domain-MTL (both regression AND classification)

strict_morgan_v336.protocol_description: Protocol 1 (Strict-Morgan, apples-to-apples with v33.6): Excludes every training compound with Exact InChIKey14/compound_key match OR Morgan-2048 radius-2 Tc >= 0.40 OR canonical 3-mer sequence Jaccard >= 0.40 to any of the 11 FDA 2019-2023 peptides (applied identically to target AND auxiliary Domain-MTL tasks).

hemolysis_predicted_probability_summary.caveat: Approved clinical peptides lack uniform in vitro RBC HC50 labels; reported strictly as predicted-probability sanity check, NOT as a ground-truth false-positive rate.

peptide_structural_v34.protocol_description: Protocol 2 (Peptide-Structural): Excludes every training compound with Exact InChIKey14/compound_key match OR Global/3-mer Sequence Identity >= 0.40 OR Close-Analog Morgan-2048 radius-2 Tc >= 0.65 OR Same Non-Trivial Murcko Scaffold / Macrocycle Ring-System Core to any of the 11 FDA 2019-2023 peptides (removes true homologs & structural analogs without saturating on generic peptide-bond Morgan bits; applied identically to target AND auxiliary Domain-MTL tasks).
